statement:
(K V : Type) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace K V] {A B} (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
  LinearAlgebraGame.span K V A ⊆ LinearAlgebraGame.span K V B
name: LinearAlgebraGame.span_mono
content:
`span_mono` is a proof that the span of sets is monotonic. Simply, this means that if you have `h : A ⊆ B`,
then `span_mono K V h` is a proof that `span K V A ⊆ span K V B`.
